Prices rose 0.6% on a monthly basis, driving the annual rate to 3.8%, the highest since May 2023, according to the latest Consumer Price Index data released Tuesday by the Bureau of Labor Statistics. -@CNN

ABC: The DOJ is investigating a series of suspiciously timed trades in the oil market just ahead of major announcements by Trump about the war against Iran, sources told ABC News. Question: Does China see the Iran war as a U.S. victory or a loss?

Myron Brilliant: “I think China sees this as a weakening of U.S. Position around the world. They see it as an opportunity to expand global influence. Why? I think they got to be careful not to be too confident and overplay their hand, because they think that the United States overplayed its hand, and they're not going to get much out of this.”
